_comment: `image` is the file stem without .png, or null when it still needs drawing.
Thirteen rituals already had artwork shipped — these are the 'orphan' files
that looked unused because they belong to the ritual set, not HABIT_LIBRARY.
The rest are generated into <ritual-id>.png and wired by the same resolver.

red-light-panel.prompt: a slim upright red-light therapy panel on a small stand, its face glowing a soft warm red

epsom-salt-bath.prompt: a simple bathtub with two soft curls of steam above it and a small bowl of white salt crystals beside it

magnesium-flake-bath.prompt: a simple bathtub with gentle steam and a small glass jar of white flakes with a scoop beside it

castor-oil-pack.prompt: a folded warm flannel cloth beside a small amber bottle of golden oil

biocellulose-mask.prompt: a simple sheet face mask laid softly over a small folded towel

facial-massage.prompt: two gentle hands cupping a calm abstract face seen from the side, eyes closed

scalp-massage.prompt: a hand resting on the crown of a head shown in simple profile, with two small circular motion arrows

yin-yoga.prompt: a simple figure folded forward in a long relaxed seated stretch on a mat

spa-day.prompt: a rolled towel, a small lit candle and a sprig of eucalyptus leaves beside it

float-tank.prompt: a rounded egg-shaped floatation pod with its lid open and a still water surface inside

acupuncture.prompt: three very fine needles resting in a small folded cloth beside a tiny bowl

sound-bath.prompt: a brass singing bowl with a wooden mallet resting across it and two soft concentric rings above
